response:
The new subtable reader bounds decoding to each subtable’s bytes. `_readClassicSubstitutions` converts entry offsets to signed values and reads every glyph in the range from `ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset` to `floor(size / 2) - offset`, clipped to the font’s glyph range, so both negative and positive offsets include all replacement words within the required bounds.
